key: 從教務處歷年課程表找到「動遊系」，先核對入學年與一般班、技優班。把自己的那一份存下來，之後選課與畢業檢核都用它比對。
old: Find 'Department of Animation and Game Design' in the Office of Academic Affairs curriculum catalog across academic years, and check your enrollment year as well as regular class or Special Talent Program. Save your copy to reference later during course selection and graduation audits.

key: 一般班p1；114/115技優專班p2另有規範。附件回application/octet-stream，實為PDF。
old: Regular class p1; 114/115 Special Talent Program p2 has separate regulations. Attachment returns application/octet-stream, which is actually a PDF.

key: 技優班條件另核，請帶自己的入學年度課表向系辦確認。
old: Special Talent Program requirements are audited separately; please bring your academic entry year curriculum roadmap to the department office for confirmation.

key: 一般班最低要幾學分？技優班也一樣嗎？
old: What is the minimum credit requirement for regular classes? Is it the same for the Special Talent Program?

key: 112至115入學一般日四技課表列最低128學分，各類別與零學分必修仍須完成。技優班不能直接套用一般班條件。
old: Curriculum for 112 to 115 entry regular day four-year program lists a minimum of 128 credits; each category and zero-credit required courses must still be completed. Special Talent Program cannot directly apply regular class conditions.

key: 技優班條件另核；畢業認列與獎助資格，請分別向系辦、職發中心確認。
old: Special Talent Program requirements are audited separately; please verify graduation recognition and subsidy eligibility with the department office and Career Development Center respectively.
